title: prunus avium f. mamillaris
intro: Prunus avium f. mamillaris, commonly known as wild cherry, is a variant of the sweet cherry plant, characterized by its unique mamillate (bead-like) fruit. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Prunus avium f. mamillaris include its ability to soothe coughs, reduce fever, and alleviate gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
